notes.title: The Crown Has Been Claimed: Crown of Exile Is Now on Steam
notes.content:
[h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45686364/a06b9056a9f7bdaf709e9cc1325fa7c95923f1ee.png"][/img][i][b]Crown of Exile[/b][/i][b] is now live on Steam.[/b][/h1][p][/p][h3]In a world where thrones are lost and loyalties fracture like glass, [i]Crown of Exile[/i] finally steps into the light. Wield influence, bear betrayal, and decide who you become when the world unravels. Your path is yours to carve, but power always has a price.[/h3][p][/p][h3]After years of writing, revising, and weaving choice into consequence, I’m so proud (and a little nervous!) to unveil the official [b]Steam Store Page[/b] for my debut interactive fiction game.[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]♦ One million+ words[/b]
♦ [b]Unforgiving politics[/b]
♦ [b]Divinity. Betrayal. Survival.[/b][/h3][h3][/h3][h3]If you’ve ever wanted to rule, run, or simply endure. This is a story shaped by your decisions, not fate.[/h3][p][/p][h2]► Click [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715550/Crown_of_Exile/?beta=0" buttoncolor="#ff0026"][b]here[/b][/url][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2715550/Crown_of_Exile/?beta=0" buttoncolor="#ff0026"] [/url]to wishlist [i]Crown of Exile[/i][/h2][p][/p][h3]Your support, even just a wishlist, makes a real difference and helps more players discover the story.[/h3]
